Team — and Matt/Acme,

We’re starting Q2 alignment for the inference product line. I’ve attached the Q2_OKR_matrix_v1 and a short rollback_backstop_plan. Need two things by EOD today:

1) Internal owners — confirm you accept the numeric anchors (KRs) in column B. If you have a concrete objection, state which KR and your suggested value.

2) Approve the rollback/backstop policy for canary failures (document attached). This is the operational fallback we’ll use if a quality regression is detected post-rollout.

Notes: the anchors emphasize latency and cost/unit improvements (we're aiming for a 7% unit-cost reduction via batching & caching experiments) plus reliability gates for dedicated customers. Acme — you’re included so legal can see the rollback language and confirm we’re OK for the Dedicated pilot toggle.

I’m calling this a short decision window so engineering and CS can finalize runbooks for the QBR. If I don’t hear a concrete no by 17:00 PT, I’ll assume tacit approval and publish to the Decision Log.

Attachments: Q2_OKR_matrix_v1.xlsx (owners column filled), rollback_backstop_plan.md

Thanks —
